question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"pass on."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Pass on"** means to give or transfer something to someone else. (किसी दूसरे को कुछ देना या हस्तांतरित करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Some organizations **passed on**__ substantially less money to the candidates.*
 
 
 
• This phrasal verb is often used in the context of passing on information or a message.
 
• The verb **"pass"** can also mean to move past something or someone, but in this case, the phrasal verb** "pass on"** is the correct choice.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

Indian culture treats guests as God and serves them and takes care of them as if they are a part and __parcel__ of the family itself. Even though we don’t have anything to eat, the guests are never left hungry and are always __looked__ after by the members of the family. Elders and respect for elders is a major component in Indian culture. Elders are the __driving__ force for any family and hence the love and respect for elders comes from __within__ and is not artificial. An individual takes blessings from his elders by touching their feet. Elders drill and __**pass on**__ the Indian culture within us as we grow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, **"put on," **means to wear clothing or to apply something (like makeup). (कपड़े पहनना या कुछ लगाना (जैसे मेकअप))
 
• Option 3, **"hold on,"** means to wait or to pause for a moment. (एक पल के लिए रुकना)
 
• Option 4,** "grow on,"** means to become more appealing over time (usually in reference to a person, thing, or idea). (समय के साथ और अधिक आकर्षक बनना (आमतौर पर किसी व्यक्ति, चीज़ या विचार के संदर्भ में))
